subject.title: [Feature Request] Multi-window session support - new window pauses existing sessions

question: Should macOS WebChat support multiple concurrent normal chat windows now, and what should own active-session focus when several windows are open?
rationale: Current source proves the single-window limitation, but the fix changes native window ownership, session subscriptions, active-focus routing, and adjacent voice/approval behavior.

options.title: Design multi-window WebChat
options.body: Keep this issue open and define a keyed window-controller model with active-focus and session subscription rules before implementation.

options.title: Defer to broader macOS UI work
options.body: Keep this issue linked to broader macOS companion UI work if maintainers want bubbles, tabs, or another window model to settle first.

options.title: Keep single-window behavior
options.body: Close only after an explicit maintainer decision that macOS WebChat should remain a single-window session-switcher surface.

recommendation.title: Design multi-window WebChat
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define a keyed window-controller model with active-focus and session subscription rules before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the macOS WebChat/window ownership path.
